title: ascm bundle-root index frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of docs/index.md, the only index.md that carries any. It declares the OKF version and nothing else.
$comment: Separate from frontmatter.schema.json because the root index is reserved and shares no field with ordinary documents. Any other index.md must have no frontmatter at all, which the validator enforces.

okf_version.description: The OKF version the bundle conforms to. A quoted string, because the unquoted YAML 0.2 is a number.
